set.body: Goal: real font measurement behind the TextMetrics capability: JVM via java.awt.FontMetrics in a jvm source set, JS via canvas measureText shim, portable estimator stays the shared default. Acceptance: TextMetrics implementations live behind platform boundaries (no JVM deps in shared); layout solver output tightens with real metrics but stays deterministic per platform; tests compare estimator vs platform metrics tolerances.
set.title: Graphics: platform text metrics
